summary: A static, notebook-level audit with no code run and no vectors downloaded. It found the LinearSVC-vs-LDA mismatch, the missing Eq. 2, evaluation, alignment and hard-debias code, the attribute-list problems, the noun-list quality, the FR hybrid slips (cells 274, 296, 307), the `a+b/2` PCA bug and the dot-vs-cosine issue. It noticed the identical Shift/Hybrid statistics and the unreproduced p-values but did not explain them. It missed the circularity of the post-Shift statistic, the missing b_w, the masculine-cue test design, the attribute/inanimate overlap, the Table 2 candidate-set explanation, and most low items. Calibration is good: findings are hedged, no listed false claims were made, and no flawed items were endorsed.
